benefit: Trailing petunias planted on bean row edges deter potato leafhopper, a major cause of 'hopper burn' in bush beans. Petunia volatiles disrupt leafhopper host orientation.

members.title: Petunia border at bean planting
members.body: Transplant trailing petunias every 36 inches along the windward edge of bean rows at planting time. Refresh if heat kills plants midseason.
